notes.title: Announcement of the resolution of a problem
notes.content:
[h3]【Chloe's Requiem -encore-】Announcement of the resolution of a problem[/h3].

Thank you for playing “Chloe's Requiem -encore-”.

Due to the influence of some anti-virus software, there was a bug that prevented this title from starting up properly on Steam.

The game can now be played without any problems.

We apologize again for any inconvenience caused.
We look forward to your continued support of “Chloe's Requiem -encore-”.

notes.title: Notice for Players of "Chloe's Requiem -encore-"
notes.content:
[h2][b]Notice for Players of "Chloe's Requiem -encore-"[/b][/h2].

Currently, an issue has been reported where the game cannot be played on Steam due to interference from certain antivirus software.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

We are currently preparing a fixed build.
An update will be released in the coming days, so we kindly ask for your patience until then.

notes.title: 「Con amore」Added - ver1.1 Updated
notes.content:
[h1][i]ーーThat performance, once more.[/i][/h1]

Thank you everyone for supporting this game, one month from its release!
Today, we are announcing that Con amore will be added to the game!

[h3]Addition of Con amore[/h3]
The side story [i]Chloe's Requiem -Con amore-[/i] has been added.
After beating the main game, Con amore will be unlocked
The player will enjoy the story from the perspective of the cats, and collect songs to help the cursed people in the manor. 
The endings will changed based on the songs collected
※To unlock Con Amore, one of the endings of the main game need to be beaten. 

If your save data has been deleted, please contact support@annulus.com for the cleared save file. 

[h3]Fixed Chinese/h3]
[list]
[*]Options
[*]Map Names
[*]Item Names
[*]Dialogue
Increased Quality of Translation
[/list]
